### GT function

```{r load-data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(rlang)
library(cbbplotR)

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}
```

### FF table

```{r ff-tbl, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

fix_names <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Uconn"        ~ "UConn",
    x == "Connecticut"  ~ "UConn",
    .default = x
  )
}

ncaa_ff_split <- readr::read_csv("ncaa_ff.csv")

ncaa_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ncaa_ff_split |> 
    dplyr::select(year = year_a, champ = champ_a, team1 = team1_a, team2 = team2_a, team3 = team3_a),
  ncaa_ff_split |> 
    dplyr::select(year = year_b, champ = champ_b, team1 = team1_b, team2 = team2_b, team3 = team3_b)
) |>
  dplyr::filter(year != 2020) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(year)

f4_outcomes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ncaa_long |> 
    dplyr::select(year, team = champ) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(sat_win = 1, mon_win = 1, mon_loss = 0, sat_loss = 0),
  
  ncaa_long |> 
    dplyr::select(year, team = team1) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(sat_win = 1, mon_win = 0, mon_loss = 1, sat_loss = 0),
  
  ncaa_long |> 
    dplyr::select(year, team = team2) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(sat_win = 0, mon_win = 0, mon_loss = 0, sat_loss = 1),
  ncaa_long |> 
    dplyr::select(year, team = team3) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(sat_win = 0, mon_win = 0, mon_loss = 0, sat_loss = 1)
) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(team) |>
  dplyr::mutate(team = fix_names(team))

stats_table <- f4_outcomes |>
  dplyr::group_by(team) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_apps    = dplyr::n(),
    titles        = sum(mon_win),
    runners_up    = sum(mon_loss),
    f4_wins       = sum(sat_win) + sum(mon_win),
    f4_losses     = sum(sat_loss) + sum(mon_loss),
    total_games   = f4_wins + f4_losses,
    all_years     = list(year),
    title_years   = list(year[mon_win == 1]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    f4_record    = paste0(f4_wins, "-", f4_losses),
    f4_pct       = f4_wins / total_games,
    title_record = paste0(titles, "-", runners_up),
    title_pct = dplyr::if_else((titles + runners_up) > 0, titles / (titles + runners_up), 0),
    f4_history   = purrr::map2_chr(all_years, title_years, \(yrs, t_yrs) {
      yrs |> 
        sort() |> 
        purrr::map_chr(\(y) {
          if(y %in% t_yrs) {
            # Uses inline CSS for color and size (1.2em is ~20% larger than default)
            paste0("<span style='color: #D4AF37; font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold;'>", y, "</span>")
          } else {
            as.character(y)
          }
        }) |>
        paste(collapse = ", ")
    })
  ) 


bball_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-basketball.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>NCAA Champions Since 1985</span>
       <span style='font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>A list of every program with at <b>least one</b> NCAA title since 1985. <br>Shows Final Four appearances and overall record, title game appearances and overall record, and sorts teams by national titles across four decades of March Madness.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
        <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-basketball.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)


ff_tbl <- stats_table |>
  dplyr::filter(titles > 0) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    titles = as.integer(titles),
    titles_display = purrr::map2_chr(titles, f4_history, \(n, history) {
      icons <- if (n > 0) {
        purrr::map_chr(seq_len(n), \(i) fontawesome::fa("trophy", fill = "orange")) |>
          paste(collapse = " ")
      } else { "" }
      paste0(icons, "<br><small>", history, "</small>")
    })
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(titles), -title_pct, -f4_pct) |> 
  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(team, team) |> 
  dplyr::select(
    team, 
    total_apps, 
    f4_record,
    f4_pct,
    title_record,
    title_pct, 
    titles_display
  ) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_gtutils() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c(team, titles_display)) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = f4_pct,
    col2 = f4_record,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = title_pct,
    col2 = title_record,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_align(columns = team, align = "left") |> 
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(f4_pct, title_pct), decimals = 3) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    columns = c(total_apps, f4_pct),
    label = "Final Fours"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_spanner(
    columns = c(title_pct, titles_display),
    label = "Title Games"
  ) |> 
  gtUtils::gt_column_subheaders(
    titles_display = list(heading = "Titles", subtitle = "Final Four + Title Years"),
    heading_color = "black",
    subtitle_color = "gray"
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    team = "",
    total_apps = "Total",
    f4_pct = "Win %",
    title_pct = "Win %"
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_add_divider(
    columns = c(title_pct), 
    sides = "left",
    color = "black",
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(bball_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note =
      gt::html(
        "<hr>Data via ncaa.com | theme via {gtUtils} <br>
        <b>Michigan won 2026 National Title beating UConn 69-63</b><br>
        <hr><b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart</b>"
      )
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(rows = c(9), fill = "#c1f8c1",
                              bold_target_only = TRUE,
                              target_col = "team") |> 
  gt::cols_width(
    gt::ends_with("team") ~ gt::px(95),
    gt::ends_with("apps") ~ gt::px(65),
    gt::ends_with("pct") ~ gt::px(65),
    gt::ends_with("display") ~ gt::px(145)
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(675)) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    locations = gt::cells_source_notes(),
    style = gt::cell_text(
      font = gt::google_font("Signika Negative"),
      size = gt::px(11.5),
      weight = 250
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(font = gt::google_font("Signika Negative"),
                    size = gt::px(14)
      )
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      rows = gt::everything(),
      columns = gt::everything()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners(),
    style = gt::cell_text(
      font = gt::google_font("Signika Negative"),
      weight = 850,
      size = gt::px(15)
    )
  ) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#0d1e2d", "#c1d6e2",
                                   "#f07e1d"))


gt_save_crop(
  ff_tbl,
  file = "f4_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "#FFFDF5"
)


ff_tbl
```

### UNC chart

```{r unc-chart, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

unc_raw <- readr::read_csv("unc-history.csv")

eras <- tibble::tibble(
  era_label = c(
    "Frank McGuire",
    "Dean Smith",
    "Bill Guthridge",
    "Matt Doherty",
    "Roy Williams",
    "Hubert Davis",
    "New Era"
  ),
  year_start = c(1954, 1963, 1998, 2001, 2004, 2022, 2027),
  year_end = c(1962, 1997, 2000, 2003, 2021, 2026, 2029),
  era_color = c(
    "#b9d7ed",
    "#56a0d3",
    "#b9d7ed",
    "#56a0d3",
    "#b9d7ed",
    "#56a0d3",
    "#DDDDDD"
  )
)

acct_years <- c(
  1957,
  1967,
  1968,
  1969,
  1972,
  1975,
  1977,
  1979,
  1981,
  1982,
  1989,
  1991,
  1994,
  1997,
  1998,
  2007,
  2008,
  2016
)

accrs_years <- c(
  1956,
  1957,
  1959,
  1960,
  1961,
  1967,
  1968,
  1969,
  1971,
  1972,
  1976,
  1977,
  1978,
  1979,
  1982,
  1983,
  1984,
  1985,
  1987,
  1988,
  1993,
  1995,
  2001,
  2005,
  2007,
  2008,
  2009,
  2011,
  2012,
  2016,
  2017,
  2019,
  2024
)

unc <- unc_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.integer(stringr::str_sub(Season, 1, 4)) + 1L
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(year >= 1954, !is.na(SRS)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    eras |> dplyr::select(era_label, year_start, year_end),
    by = dplyr::join_by(year >= year_start, year <= year_end)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ncaa_label = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(
        `NCAA Tournament`,
        "Won.*National Final"
      ) ~ "\U0001F3C6",
      stringr::str_detect(`NCAA Tournament`, "Lost.*National Final") ~ "RU",
      stringr::str_detect(`NCAA Tournament`, "Lost.*National Semi") ~ "F4",
      stringr::str_detect(`NCAA Tournament`, "Lost.*Regional Final") ~ "E8",
      stringr::str_detect(`NCAA Tournament`, "Lost.*Regional Semi") ~ "S16",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ncaa_color = dplyr::case_when(
      ncaa_label == "\U0001F3C6" ~ "#FFD700",
      ncaa_label == "RU" ~ "#333333",
      ncaa_label == "F4" ~ "#333333",
      ncaa_label == "E8" ~ "#333333",
      ncaa_label == "S16" ~ "#333333",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ncaa_bold = dplyr::if_else(
      ncaa_label %in% c("\U0001F3C6", "RU", "F4"),
      "bold",
      "plain"
    ),
    acct = dplyr::if_else(year %in% acct_years, "ACCT", NA_character_),
    accrs = dplyr::if_else(
      year %in% accrs_years & !(year %in% acct_years),
      "ACCRS",
      NA_character_
    ),
    bar_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      ncaa_label == "\U0001F3C6" ~ "gold",
      !is.na(ncaa_label) | !is.na(acct) | !is.na(accrs) ~ "notable",
      TRUE ~ "quiet"
    )
  )

unc_gold <- unc |> dplyr::filter(bar_tier == "gold")
unc_notable <- unc |> dplyr::filter(bar_tier == "notable")
unc_quiet <- unc |> dplyr::filter(bar_tier == "quiet")
unc_ncaa <- unc |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(ncaa_label))
unc_acct <- unc |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(acct))
unc_accrs <- unc |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(accrs))

era_lines <- tibble::tibble(
  yintercept = c(1962.5, 1997.5, 2000.5, 2003.5, 2021.5, 2026.5)
)

era_label_pos <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c(
    "Frank<br>McGuire",
    "Dean<br>Smith",
    "Bill<br>Guthridge",
    "Matt<br>Doherty",
    "Roy<br>Williams",
    "Hubert<br>Davis",
    "Michael<br>Malone"
  ),
  y = c(1960, 1980, 1999, 2002, 2012.5, 2024, 2028),
  x = 31.5,
  hjust = 0.5
)

new_era_bars <- tibble::tibble(
  year = 2027:2029,
  SRS = 15,
  era_label = "New Era"
)

unc_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +

  # Era background shading
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = eras,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = year_start - 0.5,
      ymax = year_end + 0.5,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = era_label
    ),
    alpha = 0.07
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Frank McGuire" = "#b9d7ed",
      "Dean Smith" = "#56a0d3",
      "Bill Guthridge" = "#b9d7ed",
      "Matt Doherty" = "#56a0d3",
      "Roy Williams" = "#b9d7ed",
      "Hubert Davis" = "#56a0d3",
      "New Era" = "#DDDDDD"
    )
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  ggplot2::geom_col(
    data = unc_quiet,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = SRS, y = year, fill = SRS),
    width = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.9,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#e8f2fa",
    high = "#b9d7ed",
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  # Notable bars — distinct blue
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    data = unc_notable,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = SRS, y = year),
    fill = "#56a0d3",
    width = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.92,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  # Gold bars — championship / star seasons
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    data = unc_gold,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = SRS, y = year),
    fill = "#FFD700",
    width = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.92,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_col(
    data = new_era_bars,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = SRS, y = year),
    fill = "#DDDDDD",
    alpha = 0.35,
    width = 0.75,
    color = "#AAAAAA",
    linetype = "solid",
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    data = era_lines,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(yintercept = yintercept),
    color = "#666666",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +

  # Era labels
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = era_label_pos,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = 2.5,
    color = "#444444",
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    lineheight = 0.9,
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA,
    label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt"),
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +

  # Zero reference line
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "#999999",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 17.5,
    y = 2028,
    label = "???",
    color = "#AAAAAA",
    size = 4,
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # NCAA Tournament labels
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = unc_ncaa,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(
      x = SRS + 0.7,
      y = year,
      label = ncaa_label,
      color = ncaa_color,
      fontface = ncaa_bold
    ),
    size = 2.6,
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    hjust = 0
  ) +

  # ACCT labels
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = unc_acct,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = -0.6, y = year, label = acct),
    size = 2.2,
    color = "#E07B00",
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 1
  ) +

  # ACCRS labels (regular season only, no tournament title that year)
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = unc_accrs,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = -0.6, y = year, label = accrs),
    size = 2.0,
    color = "#E07B00",
    family = "Roboto Condensed",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 1
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_color_identity() +

  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5),
    limits = c(-5, 34),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1955, 2030, by = 5),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +

  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "This is Carolina Basketball Since the 1950s",
    subtitle = "Shows the season simple-rating-system (SRS) by coaching era.<br>Highlights each season's success across the NCAA Tournament and ACC:<br>  **Sweet 16 (S16) | Elite 8 (E8) | Final Four (F4) | Runner-up (RU) | Championships \U0001F3C6** <br>
    <span style='color:#E07B00;'>**ACC Tournament Championships (ACCT)**</span> or <span style='color:#E07B00;'>**ACC Regular Season first place finishes (ACCRS)**</span><br>SRS rates teams using average point differential and strength of schedule.<br> Carolina is in the top-five all-time in SRS out of 495 programs.",
    x = "SRS",
    y = "",
    caption = "If a season ended in both ACCRS + ACCT, only ACCT is shown<br>data via sports-reference.com and wikipedia.com <br>Viz by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  ) +

  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_rc() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      family = "Roboto Condensed",
      margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 4)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 10,
      color = "grey40",
      family = "Roboto Condensed",
      lineheight = 1.4,
      margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 10)
    ),
    plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey50",
      family = "Roboto Condensed"
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(16, 32, 12, 16)
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  "unc_srs_hist.png",
  plot = unc_plot,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 10.5,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)

unc_plot
```
